payload.business_context: T4H multi-business signal mining, opportunity routing, IP/product discovery, content system, network intelligence graph.

sweepers.name: linkedin.signal.miner
sweepers.purpose: Extract atomic business, product, market, relationship and personal-intent signals from LinkedIn activity.

sweepers.name: linkedin.opportunity.detector
sweepers.purpose: Detect leads, sales opportunities, partnership opportunities, hiring/collab opportunities and customer pain.

sweepers.name: linkedin.content.deconstructor
sweepers.purpose: Reverse-engineer high-performing posts/articles into reusable content patterns.

sweepers.name: linkedin.idea.extractor
sweepers.purpose: Turn posts, comments and repeated explanations into product, IP, agent and pack candidates.

sweepers.name: linkedin.network.mapper
sweepers.purpose: Build a person/company graph showing buyers, amplifiers, collaborators, experts, critics and dormant relationships.

sweepers.name: linkedin.intent.parser
sweepers.purpose: Detect buying, partnering, hiring, media, investment, advisory and research intent.

sweepers.name: linkedin.gap.finder
sweepers.purpose: Identify unanswered questions, market confusion, missing explainers, content gaps and product gaps.

sweepers.name: linkedin.recycler
sweepers.purpose: Find old posts/articles/comments worth refreshing, recombining or turning into campaigns.

sweepers.name: linkedin.angle.generator
sweepers.purpose: Extract contrarian, polarising or high-attention angles and generate safe variants.

sweepers.name: linkedin.knowledge.sync
sweepers.purpose: Sync links, references, docs, named systems, claims and entities into the knowledge spine with provenance.

sweepers.name: linkedin.business.router
sweepers.purpose: Map every useful signal to one or more of the active businesses, brands, products, agents or operational queues.

rules: Read-only scrape/inspect first; no posting, deleting, messaging or external action without gated approval.
Every generated job must include idempotency_key, source_ref, evidence grade and rollback note.
Route only high-confidence opportunities directly to PEN; uncertain items go to WIP for review/enrichment.
No credentials in payloads or receipts. Use existing vault/connector secrets only.
Receipt must include counts scanned, counts classified, jobs enqueued, failures, skipped items and proof refs.
definition_of_done: Sweeper suite registered or queued for registration.
At least one dry-run/read-only pass executed if LinkedIn data source is available.
Receipt saved under receipts/runtime/ with idempotency_key linkedin-sweeper-suite-001.
Any generated child jobs use stable dedupe keys and include source provenance.
If LinkedIn data source is unavailable, receipt states blocked reason and exact connector/export required.

meta.handover: User requested LinkedIn data/articles/shares sweepers for businesses; finish and send to PEN; validate handover with GitHub receipts.
